fidelity.interpretation: A/A controls also differ numerically, predominantly in critic/model arrays. Both controls used8 retries; profile and original production used9. This does not prove the probes leave GPU execution numerically identical. Do not interpret elapsed-time differences as an optimization or a clean estimate of profiler overhead.

interpretation: Prefetch queues were generally ready; simply adding prefetch depth is not the leading target.

GPU execution is fragmented into many very short kernels and internal device-to-host control transfers. Raw trace operation names include GRU while-loop predicates, GRU gradient TensorList bookkeeping and Dense/Tensordot shape transfers.
Unfused recurrent execution and graph control/shape placement are strong optimization candidates. These observations are not a measured counterfactual speedup.
Record gathering, collation and serialized packing are also expensive, especially for repeated full-data guard scans. Their timings overlap other work.
The explicit one-result-per-minibatch Python synchronization is small in this profile; it should not be assumed to explain the idle time.

next_experiment.priority: Benchmark a compatible fused recurrent execution path or reduce graph-internal shape/control round trips, retaining the architecture, initial weights, batch512 and RL recipe.
next_experiment.secondary: Reduce repeated decoding/packing for guard scans using numerical indexed/prepacked data.
next_experiment.validation: Use frozen-data microbenchmarks and report numerical/guard trajectory differences explicitly; no speedup inferred from these profiling/control timings.

tests.scope: CPU parity, cached and spilled concurrent updates; GPU clock alignment/raw-stream exclusion and interval accounting. Strict GPU replay parity did not pass.

limitations: One frozen round and one30s trace during concurrent actor/critic work; activity fraction is not whole-run utilization or peak FLOPS.
GPU sampling is global device activity; raw CUDA trace belongs to the replay.
Overlapping host spans are not additive shares of total wall time.
Isolated update replays omit the original resident game-generation/validation processes; absolute times are not an optimization comparison to the production run.
